agentic_composition_plan.repository_summary: Aspose.Cells FOSS for Rust is a pure-Rust library for reading and writing Excel .xlsx files, implementing a subset of Aspose.Cells functionality with verified capabilities including workbook round-tripping, type-specific cell value assignment, formula evaluation, comment management, and data validation. It is early-stage, MIT-licensed, and installed via Git or local path dependencies.
